name: @just-oc/plugins
description: Project-local TypeScript plugins for OpenCode and Kilo.

scripts.validate:plugins: bun --eval "const context = { client: {} }; for (const path of ['./plugins/background-tasks/index.ts', './plugins/zellij/index.ts']) { const plugin = (await import(path)).default; const hooks = await plugin(context); if (!hooks || !hooks.tool) throw new Error(path + ' did not initialize tools'); } await import('./.opencode/plugins/background-tasks.ts'); await import('./.opencode/plugins/zellij.ts');"
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run validate:plugins
